title: Three point pair value
statement: Let $x\colon\{0,1\}\to\{a,b,c\}$. The pair value is $4/9$ if both coordinates equal $c$, is $-2/9$ if at least one coordinate equals $c$ but they do not both equal $c$, and is $1/9$ if neither coordinate equals $c$.
hypotheses_covered: x maps {0,1} into the three-point set {a,b,c}
